messages:
sylvie: Heads-up — planning a surgical patch (very small delta) to v2.8.2 to address a kv-cache timeout regression. Target cutoff 21:30 PT today. No model or perf profile changes, just a runtime fix. Please call out any blockers now.
omar: Ack. I can take the cherry-pick + runtime tweak. Will not land any unrelated changes.
jen: FYI I'm offline 18:00-21:00 PT but can quick-review P0s if labeled.
release-bot: Reminder: release window scheduled at 21:30 PT. Auto-smoke will run on merge.
ryan: Quick question — are we reverting commit 3f2a1e or applying a small guard patch?
sylvie: Prefer a guard patch that adds a bounds check and a unit test. Revert only if the patch fails in canary.
lucy: I've prepared branch release/v2.8.2-surgical with two commits: fix + test. PR #4578 opened, CI green locally.
omar: Picking now: `git checkout -b hotfix/2.8.2-surgical && git cherry-pick 3f2a1e 4b5c6d` — will push the branch shortly.
sylvie: @jen @ryan pls review ASAP. Changelog line should be a single line: "Fix kv-cache timeout that could lead to OOM on long contexts". Keep wording terse.
jen: Reviewing now, small test nit. Will approve if CI stays green. :thumbsup:
lucy: Smoke run on staging shows no regression — 200rps sustained, p50 unchanged.
omar: Merged to release branch after minor test tweak. CI reported merge at 1777777055.
sylvie: Plan: after merge, start canary at 10% for 15m, watch error budgets and latency. If good, roll to 100% progressively. Rollback command if needed: `./ops/release/rollback.sh v2.8.2`
ryan: I'll watch alerts and rollback hooks during canary window.
jen: Merged and tagged, changelog updated. Leaving post-merge note in the PR.
sylvie: Thanks all — minimal diffs, low blast radius. If anyone notices post-rollout anomalies, post here and tag me. :rocket:
